verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent operated conversationally. You drive it from a TUI session where it reads the codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests and presents a diff. `byteask exec` runs a single task to completion, and `byteask queue` sends messages into a running session, with slash commands usable mid-conversation. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or example of natural-language prompts (it is implied by the agent and conversation framing rather than shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
